note: Typed tool routes. One row per MCP server Forge knows how to route work to. Rows are host-neutral by construction: a row names the SERVER, never a host's spelling of its tool namespace. The host registry owns that spelling and composes the concrete namespace at render time, so adding a host never edits this file and adding a server never edits host code.
rules: Every id must match a dependency id in catalog.json. One dependency truth, not two.
A row grants tools only to an agent that declares the matching capability, and only on a host that provides every entry in requires_host_provides.
A row without a resolvable probe is not routable. Detection is never assumed from installation.
fallbacks must name the same route catalog.json declares for the dependency, so a missing server degrades instead of blocking.
Lane ids carry a lane. prefix. Capability ids never do, so a lane and a capability cannot collide in the same namespace.

probe_kinds.mcp-server-declared: The server id appears in an MCP client configuration the host declares in hosts/registry.json mcp.config_paths. Read-only: it inspects configuration and never starts, installs, or contacts a server.
probe_kinds.mcp-http-handshake: The server answers an MCP initialize request at its declared http endpoint. Contacts a server already running on this machine; never starts, installs, or writes anything. A pass is evidence the route is live, so it earns AVAILABLE_VERIFIED where a declaration alone earns only AVAILABLE_UNVERIFIED.

lanes.lane.ue-editor: Live Unreal editor session. Exclusive: native typed calls, live scripting, editor-closed commandlets and human editor work all contend for it.
lanes.lane.dcc-authoring: External DCC authoring session. Runs concurrently with ue.editor because it writes intermediate assets, not the project.

providers.implementation: Unreal Engine's first-party Unreal MCP plugin (ModelContextProtocol), Experimental since 5.8. The editor hosts the server; Forge never starts it.

requires_engine.note: ModelContextProtocol serves the endpoint; without AllToolsets it advertises no tools. The editor must be open for the route to answer.

providers.tool_surface: Discovery mode by default: list_toolsets, describe_toolset and call_tool stand in for the full tool set, so the schema stays small. Treat named tools as discovered at runtime, never as a fixed contract.
